pendingWorkGroups.name: Raw HTML syntax, precedence, and safe schema projection
pendingWorkGroups.requiredProof: Keep raw HTML inert by default; define safe opt-in schema projection, preserve opaque source, handle all seven block classes and inline precedence, and explicitly report unsupported or unsafe HTML. Never execute reference script/style output to increase a conformance score.

intentionalDivergences.reason: CommonMark accepts arbitrary URI schemes in autolinks; Fountain's default policy deliberately keeps unapproved schemes literal.
Fountain deliberately includes GFM-style plain web and email autolinks beyond core CommonMark, including inside otherwise literal surrounding punctuation.

Fountain adds exactly one empty paragraph to an otherwise empty document, blockquote, or list item as an editable caret host. The harness verifies that this is the only semantic difference and that exact-source and canonical round trips preserve content. These are not counted as CommonMark matches.

note: Official visible tab markers are materialized before parsing. Equivalent decoded and percent-encoded URLs are URI-canonicalized. Expected HTML and Fountain output are reduced to a neutral semantic projection that never compares or constrains either parser's native AST.
